import itertools

def simulate(N, n_rounds):
    count = 0
    for p in itertools.permutations(range(N)):
        guest_to_tag = {i: p[i] for i in range(N)}
        guests_present = list(range(N))
        for r in range(n_rounds):
            exiting = [g for g in guests_present if guest_to_tag[g] == g]
            for g in exiting:
                guests_present.remove(g)
                del guest_to_tag[g]
            if not guests_present:
                break
            m = len(guests_present)
            new_guest_to_tag = {}
            for k in range(m):
                giver = guests_present[k]
                receiver = guests_present[(k + 1) % m]
                new_guest_to_tag[receiver] = guest_to_tag[giver]
            guest_to_tag = new_guest_to_tag
        if guests_present:
            count += 1
    return count
